_comment: Goat & Co. shared skill catalogue, as seeded on startup and restored by reset. Fictional. Every skill is an inert data entry: Billy Ops reads its instructions into context, nothing is ever executed. The first line of each skill's instructions is the ground truth its step reports.

skills.name: ledger-reader
skills.description: Reads this month's expense ledger rows.
skills.instructions: Ledger read: 42 expense rows for this month, all with receipts attached.

skills.name: expense-report
skills.description: Formats expense rows as the monthly expense report.
skills.instructions: Expense reports must be filed within 30 days and need manager approval before reimbursement.

skills.name: channel-post
skills.description: Posts a message to the team channel (simulated).

skills.name: holiday-calendar
skills.instructions: Company holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Winter Break.

skills.name: vpn-guide
skills.description: Explains how to get remote VPN access.
skills.instructions: Remote VPN access requires a company laptop and multi-factor authentication.
